items.name: Data Protection Officer
items.description: A DPO is designated, resourced, and independent, and is involved in all personal-data matters; the DPO is the contact point for the authority and data subjects.
fragments: A DPO is designated, resourced, and independent, and is involved in all personal-data matters
the DPO is the contact point for the authority and data subjects.

items.name: Data Protection by Design & by Default
items.description: Privacy controls (pseudonymisation, minimisation, access limits) are embedded into architecture from inception and the system defaults to the most privacy-protective settings.
fragments: Privacy controls (pseudonymisation, minimisation, access limits) are embedded into architecture from inception and the system defaults to the most privacy-protective settings.

items.name: International Data Transfers
items.description: Personal data leaves the EEA only under a valid mechanism (adequacy, SCCs, or BCRs) with a transfer impact assessment and supplementary measures where needed (post-Schrems II).
fragments: Personal data leaves the EEA only under a valid mechanism (adequacy, SCCs, or BCRs) with a transfer impact assessment and supplementary measures where needed (post-Schrems II).

items.name: Lawful Basis for Processing
items.description: Every processing activity has one documented Art. 6 lawful basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests) recorded before any personal data is collected; legitimate-interests basis requires a documented balancing test.
fragments: Every processing activity has one documented Art. 6 lawful basis (consent, contract, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests) recorded before any personal data is collected
legitimate-interests basis requires a documented balancing test.

items.name: Personal Data Breach Notification
items.description: Breaches are detected, assessed, and notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours where required, and to affected subjects without undue delay where high risk; a breach register is maintained.
fragments: Breaches are detected, assessed, and notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours where required, and to affected subjects without undue delay where high risk
a breach register is maintained.

items.name: Processor & DPA Management
items.description: Processors and sub-processors are bound by Art. 28 data processing agreements with a documented authorisation chain, audit rights, and instruction-only processing.
fragments: Processors and sub-processors are bound by Art. 28 data processing agreements with a documented authorisation chain, audit rights, and instruction-only processing.

items.name: Purpose Limitation & Data Minimisation
items.description: Collect only data necessary for the stated purpose; every field has a documented purpose; the design rejects fields without one; no re-use for incompatible purposes.
fragments: Collect only data necessary for the stated purpose
every field has a documented purpose
the design rejects fields without one
no re-use for incompatible purposes.

items.name: Records of Processing Activities (RoPA)
items.description: A living inventory of processing activities, purposes, data categories, recipients, transfers, and retention is maintained and updated as systems change.
fragments: A living inventory of processing activities, purposes, data categories, recipients, transfers, and retention is maintained and updated as systems change.

items.name: Restriction & Objection
items.description: Processing-restriction flags and objection (including an absolute opt-out from direct marketing) are enforceable at the data layer and respected by downstream jobs.
fragments: Processing-restriction flags and objection (including an absolute opt-out from direct marketing) are enforceable at the data layer and respected by downstream jobs.

items.name: Right of Access (DSAR)
items.description: Data subjects can obtain confirmation of processing and a copy of their data plus processing metadata; fulfilment is machine-assisted and completes within one month.
fragments: Data subjects can obtain confirmation of processing and a copy of their data plus processing metadata
fulfilment is machine-assisted and completes within one month.

items.name: Right to Data Portability
items.description: The subject's provided data is exportable in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format (e.g., JSON/CSV); direct transmission to another controller where technically feasible.
fragments: The subject's provided data is exportable in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format (e.g., JSON/CSV)
direct transmission to another controller where technically feasible.

items.name: Right to Erasure
items.description: Verifiable deletion across primary stores, backups, caches, logs, and processors when erasure conditions are met; erasure/rectification is propagated to recipients (Art. 19).
fragments: Verifiable deletion across primary stores, backups, caches, logs, and processors when erasure conditions are met
erasure/rectification is propagated to recipients (Art. 19).

items.name: Security of Processing
items.description: Risk-appropriate technical and organisational measures (encryption, pseudonymisation, confidentiality, integrity, availability, resilience, restore capability) are applied and their effectiveness is tested regularly. Links to the Encryption and Application Security standards.
fragments: Risk-appropriate technical and organisational measures (encryption, pseudonymisation, confidentiality, integrity, availability, resilience, restore capability) are applied and their effectiveness is tested regularly. Links to the Encryption and Application Security standards.

items.name: Special Category Data Controls
items.description: Health, biometric, genetic and other special-category data (e.g., medical evidence in claims and underwriting) is processed only under an Art. 9(2) condition with heightened safeguards, access controls, and logging.
fragments: Health, biometric, genetic and other special-category data (e.g., medical evidence in claims and underwriting) is processed only under an Art. 9(2) condition with heightened safeguards, access controls, and logging.

items.name: Storage Limitation & Retention
items.description: Per-data-category retention schedules are enforced; automated deletion or anonymisation occurs at end of retention; no indefinite storage of identifiable data.
fragments: Per-data-category retention schedules are enforced
automated deletion or anonymisation occurs at end of retention
no indefinite storage of identifiable data.

items.name: Transparency & Privacy Notices
items.description: Art. 13/14 information is provided at or before collection in plain, layered language; the served notice version is recorded against the data subject.
fragments: Art. 13/14 information is provided at or before collection in plain, layered language
the served notice version is recorded against the data subject.
